data.title: 角楯花凛 · 黄昏窗前的女仆茶点侍奉
data.description: C&C战术备战室黄昏时分，落日余晖洒在擦拭得铮亮的狙击枪与茶具上。花凛身着整洁而勾勒曲线的黑色女仆装与白色围裙，双手端着银质茶盘微微躬身。小麦色的脸颊在夕照下透着淡淡红晕，金眸专注认真地凝视着老师，用最标准的恭顺礼节履行着专属女仆的誓言。
data.location: tactical club room with weapon cases at golden sunset
data.action: holding silver tray with porcelain teacup, bowing slightly in fitted maid uniform, dark skin, golden eyes filled with dedicated service, gentle blush
data.lighting: dazzling orange sunset light glowing through tall floor-to-ceiling glass
data.mood: dedicated maid loyalty, stunning sunset contrast
data.promptProse: Holding a silver tea tray in the C&C briefing room, Kakudate Karin bows slightly in her fitted maid uniform. Golden hour sunset illuminates her dark skin and long black hair as she looks up with quiet, devoted loyalty.
data.animaCaption: Karin serving tea in her maid uniform as warm sunset light bathes her dark skin.
